items.author: Cameron Faulkner
items.title: You can lock in Hulu and Disney Plus for as low as $5 per month for a year
items.summary: Emmy Rossum leads the fantastic cast of Furious. | Image: Hulu The Black Friday offers on streaming services are rolling in, and the latest deal includes Disney Plus and Hulu for a steeply discounted monthly rate. There are sales happening for both the ad-supported and ad-free tiers that offer full access to both services, and either will save you quite a bit of money. For those who despise ads, you can opt for the ad-free version for $14.99 per month (was $21.99) for a year, costing you $180 instead of $264 over the duration. This deal is located in a small banner near the bottom of the sale page via Hulu or Disney Plus . The ad-supported tier drops from $12.99 to just $4.99, so you’ll pay $60 over the course of the year instead of $156. You have through Cyber Monday, November 30th, at 11:59PM PST to take advantage of the lower prices. Disney Plus and Hulu bundle Where to Buy: $12.99 $4.99 at Hulu (ad-supported, monthly) $21.99 $14.99 at Hulu (ad-free, monthly) The Hulu and Disney Plus bundle is one of the best values in streaming, especially if you have kids who can’t get enough Disney movies and other cartoons. On the other hand, Hulu is home to plenty of shows made for adults, including Furious (a crime drama that gripped this household like no other show this year), The Bear , Shōgun , Alien: Earth , The Lowdown , and many more. It’s worth the subscription just for those alone. The bundle includes Star Wars and Marvel content plus fun, uplifting shows to dig into over the holidays, like Bob’s Burgers , Futurama , The Simpsons , and It’s Always Sunny in Philadelphia , to name some mainstays that tend to attract subscribers. If you’re considering other subscription services, we covered discounts on Paramount Plus (I might snag this to watch Cupertino ), HBO Max , and Peacock . ( The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins is fun!)

items.title: Harman Kardon’s classic, see-through SoundSticks 4 are half off
items.summary: Harman Kardon’s alien-looking SoundSticks became synonymous with the Mac in the early 2000s, and they sounded pretty great. But did you know the company still makes them? After selling steadily for $300 for several years and then spiking to $330 in recent months, the last-gen version of the iconic transparent speaker system is available for an all-time low of $149.99 from Harman Kardon , or $199.95 on Amazon . The discount puts them within range of most other desktop speakers you might consider sticking, or displaying, in your lounge area. Harman Kardon SoundSticks 4 audio system Where to Buy: $300 $199.99 at Amazon $300 $199.99 at Best Buy $300 $149.99 at Harman Kardon In addition to 3.5mm aux connectivity, the SoundSticks 4 support Bluetooth audio. The 2.1-channel system features two wired satellite speakers, each containing four drivers, and a powerful subwoofer encapsulated in a see-through dome. You can adjust the system’s volume by tapping the touch-sensitive plus or minus sections flanking the logo on the subwoofer. That’s not ideal if your plan was to hide the sub from sight, but I’d argue that most people interested in this model likely plan to showcase it on a shelf instead of tuck it away. items.originalTitle: Witchweed menaces maize farms across Africa: New study maps the damage
items.title: Witchweed menaces maize farms across Africa: New study maps the damage
items.summary: Over $1 billion a year. That is what a small parasitic weed plant costs maize farmers across sub-Saharan Africa every year, without ever being caught in the act. Striga, known as witchweed, latches onto maize roots underground and siphons off water and nutrients long before it breaks the surface. By the time a farmer sees the damage, the blame falls on drought or exhausted soil. For 30 years nobody could put a reliable figure on the bill, and without one, the response stayed scattered.
